name: agentflow
description: Spec-driven pipeline + TDD execution for coding agents. Skills auto-trigger; a ledger survives compaction.

interface.shortDescription: Spec, plan, task contracts, TDD, review — one flow for any coding agent
interface.longDescription: Agentflow enforces a spec->plan->tasks->execute->review->finish pipeline via auto-triggering skills, with team conventions merged in and a git-committed ledger that survives context compaction.
